vulnerabilityAlerts.description: CVE-triggered PRs (OSV/GitHub Advisory on a version you use): add security label, fix(security): prefix, bypass age gate and schedule, automerge on green CI. 1-minute floor (not 0 days) ensures Renovate posts a stability check — 0 days normalises to null internally, no check is posted, and GitHub returns state: pending with empty statuses which blocks automerge on repos without CI. relaxed behaviour because CVE fix packages may lack a releaseTimestamp.

packageRules.description: Lockfile-only (transitive) updates: automerge on green CI. 1-minute floor + relaxed ensures Renovate posts a stability check — transitive deps may lack releaseTimestamp so timestamp-required would block automerge forever.
Major updates: hold 30 days to let the ecosystem surface breaking changes and incompatibilities, then assign for manual review — no auto-merge
Patch and pin updates: hold 7 days to let the community catch supply-chain attacks before auto-merging on green CI

Digest and pinDigest updates: 1-minute floor forces Renovate to post a stability check. 0 days normalises to null internally (no check posted = branch stays pending forever on repos without CI). relaxed behaviour required because digest SHAs (GitHub Actions, Docker, etc.) carry no releaseTimestamp — with the default 'require' behaviour the check would stay PENDING forever regardless of how many times Renovate runs. internalChecksAsSuccess handles repos without CI.
Minor updates: hold 14 days to let the community catch supply-chain attacks before auto-merging on green CI
GitHub Actions: never auto-merge — workflow changes run with repo permissions and are a supply-chain risk

Security-categorised packages (e.g. cryptography, openssl — any update, not just CVE-triggered): fix(security): prefix, bypass age gate and schedule, jump queue with prPriority 10, automerge on green CI. Settings intentionally mirror vulnerabilityAlerts so both paths get the same urgency; prPriority is the only setting not covered there. 1-minute floor (not 0 days) + relaxed for the same reason as vulnerabilityAlerts: 0 days normalises to null, no check is posted, automerge is blocked on repos without CI.
Regex-managed versions: one PR per package; include from/to versions and update type
Regex-managed digest updates: no extra info in commit message — digest is self-explanatory
Regex-managed helm charts: add helm/ prefix, overrides topic from both version and digest regex rules above — commitMessageExtra is inherited from whichever of those matched first
kubernetes images: docker/ prefix, strip org/registry path keeping only image name, include from/to versions and update type
kubernetes images digest: no extra info in commit message
argocd: helm/ prefix, strip org/registry path keeping only chart name, include from/to versions and update type
argocd digest: no extra info in commit message
helmfile/helm-values: helm/ prefix, strip org/registry keeping only chart name, include from/to versions and update type
helmfile/helm-values digest: no extra info in commit message

terraform: terraform/ prefix, use resolved versions not constraint strings, include update type; bump range lower bound to the new version rather than widening the constraint; currentVersion is absent for lockfile-only updates so make the 'from' clause conditional
terraform digest: no extra info in commit message
dockerfile: docker/ prefix, strip org/registry path keeping only image name, include from/to versions and update type
dockerfile digest: no extra info in commit message
npm: add npm/ prefix, use resolved versions not constraint strings, include update type; dedupe lock file after each update
composer: composer/ prefix, from/to resolved versions and update type; bump range lower bound to the new version rather than widening the constraint
composer digest: no extra info in commit message
github-actions: action/ prefix, strip org keeping only action name, include from/to versions and update type
github-actions pin/pinDigest: lowercase action word, show target SHA, include update type (built-in uses capital Pin and overrides topic)
github-actions digest: no extra info in commit message

mbologna/.github reusable workflows: already age-gated by that repo's own Renovate run — skip stability window, bypass schedule, automerge on green CI, and clear reviewer assigned by the major rule. 1-minute floor (not 0 days) ensures Renovate posts a stability check so internalChecksAsSuccess can green-light repos without CI. relaxed release-age behaviour because github-digest SHAs carry no releaseTimestamp — timestamp-required would mark them pending forever. commitMessageExtra includes newDigestShort so each PR title is unique — without it, all digest PRs share the same title and Renovate disables automerge on subsequent ones thinking they were already merged. MUST be placed after the github-actions digest rule so its commitMessageExtra wins.
pip_requirements/pip-compile: pip/ prefix, use constraint strings (deps may be unpinned), include update type
pip_requirements/pip-compile digest: no extra info in commit message
pep621/uv: pip/ prefix, use resolved versions (always pinned), include update type
pep621/uv digest: no extra info in commit message

cargo digest: no extra info in commit message
gomod: go/ prefix, use resolved versions, include update type
gomod digest: no extra info in commit message
maven: maven/ prefix, use resolved versions, include update type
maven digest: no extra info in commit message
